findings.claim: The change does not satisfy the stated acceptance criteria because phase-completion task 6.3 remains unchecked.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria section 6 lists `- [ ] 6.3 Install/sign/read back the final binary and generation, complete artifact-refiner and distinct-model review, verify/archive the OpenSpec change, and close the KBD phase with reflection`; the committed tasks file contains the same unchecked item.
findings.suggested_fix: Complete and mark task 6.3 as done only after the required install/readback, reviews, OpenSpec archival, and phase closure evidence are committed, or remove it from the required acceptance criteria if it is not in scope.

findings.claim: A duplicate target delivery for a non-terminal `Received` or `Running` dispatch can invoke the local executor again, violating the no-reexecution replay contract.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria 2.3 and 2.4 require response-loss/replay behavior without re-execution; `RemoteTarget::receive` returns only for terminal records, otherwise accepts `PeerDispatchState::Received | PeerDispatchState::Running => accepted.record`, then still calls `self.executor.execute(&dispatch).await` after the state match.
findings.suggested_fix: Persist a local run identity before starting execution and, on duplicate delivery of `Received`/`Running`, return the durable existing state or poll/read the existing local run instead of calling `execute` again.
